description: Default capability — allows the stage window to call every catcast command plus the bits of Tauri's core/window/webview APIs the about page touches. The `remote` block also extends those permissions to whatever rotation URL the kiosk is currently displaying, so the on_page_load-injected hotkey handlers (F1/F11/F12/Ctrl+Alt+M/Esc) can invoke from external pages too. Threat model: rotation URLs are operator-trusted intranet content; we tolerate that any displayed page can call our commands.
